label: Ampang landslip terrace house

sequence: Shallow landslip of the cut slope behind Nos. 21 to 27
The slipped soil pushes over the rear retaining wall and moves the ground beneath the rear external wall of the house
The strip footing settles about 40 mm and rotates, cracking the wall and the kitchen floor slab

gates.name: Period of insurance
gates.reason: Loss on 4 January 2025 falls inside 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.

gates.name: Peril insured
gates.reason: Proximate cause: landslip of the cut slope after prolonged rain, with no intervening event. Landslip is not a base peril; FP510 extends cover to it.

gates.name: Conditions precedent
gates.reason: Notice on 4 January 2025; written claim delivered 15 January 2025, day 11 of 15.

gates.name: Endorsement held
gates.reason: FP510 (standard cover) is on the schedule.

gates.name: Endorsement satisfied
gates.reason: FP510 exclusions tested: (a) the retaining wall is admitted because the building was damaged by the same cause at the same time; (b) the floor slab is admitted because the foundation beneath the external wall was damaged by the same cause at the same time; (c) no coastal or river erosion, no demolition or structural works, and the engineer finds the foundations not defective. No warranties; Condition 9 not engaged.

gates.name: Item admitted
gates.reason: Four of five items admitted. The front driveway (ref 5) falls out: its cracking predates the loss and was not caused by the landslip. FP510 (d) excess deducted after average.

(b) loss or damage to or resulting from movement of solid floor slabs unless the foundation beneath the external walls of the Buildings are damaged by the same cause and at the same time.

ambiguity.question: Whether the settlement and rotation of the rear wall footing, with the kitchen cordoned off, is a fall or displacement under Condition 4 so that the insurance ceased.
ambiguity.expected_behaviour: Condition 4 does not apply where the cordoned kitchen is a partitioned space isolated from the rest of the house (founder, 7 Nov 2026); the family lives in the front of the house, and the adjuster does not record the layout, so flag it for the claims examiner. The second proviso points the same way: FP510 deems landslip loss to be loss by fire, so the displacement is caused by a covered peril. Approve under FP510.
